en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim b. Hashim from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Ishaq b. `Ammar. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:
Oh Ishaaq! Soften your speech with [even] the hypocrite, love the faithful believer sincerely, and [even] if a Jew were to sit with you, then be gracious in his company.
